objective.stem: Feelings of the heart such as joy, fear and anger are called ___
The feeling of being sure that you can do a thing is called ___
When we lose a game and do not fight or cry wildly, we show good ___
Nervousness before a race is best beaten by ___
A hard feeling some children get when they lose is ___
Working together with your team toward one goal is called ___
Welcoming a new child who does not know the rules of the game is ___
Accepting another child's mistake without laughing at him is ___
Playing by the rules and taking what the one who judges says is ___
Sometimes leading and sometimes following in a game teaches us ___
Marching is best described as ___
objective.answer: organised walking in rhythm and formation
distractors: running about in any way you like
hopping on only one leg around
lying down quietly on the mat

objective.stem: The foot that starts when we march forward is the ___
The command that makes everybody stand straight and keep quiet is ___
Keeping an arm's length between us in the line is done to ___
Marching is good for the body because it develops ___
distractors: having a very big and round belly
strong nails on both of the hands
a loud and a shouting voice

objective.stem: Swinging and twisting the body before running are done to ___
A jump should be landed with the knees ___
objective.answer: bent, so that the landing is soft
distractors: straight and locked at all times
lifted high up to the chest

objective.stem: Bending sideways with one arm over the head stretches the ___
objective.answer: waist and the sides of the trunk
distractors: hair and the top of the head

objective.stem: Loud, jerky movements in exercise are dangerous because they ___
objective.answer: can pull a muscle or hurt a joint
distractors: make us run much more faster
keep the whole class quite cool

objective.stem: A race run on a marked path is called a ___
After crossing the finishing line we should ___
objective.answer: keep going a little and then walk
distractors: sit right down there at once
lie flat down on the track

objective.stem: The first thing to do with a machine that gives smoke is to ___
objective.answer: leave it and tell the one in charge
distractors: pull the cable out very hard
blow the smoke away with hands
pour some cold water on it

objective.stem: Running with a partner side by side to the line is called ___
Climbing is safest when ___
objective.answer: three points stay on the ladder while one moves
distractors: two children climb one above the other
you climb fast with your eyes shut
you carry a bag in your hands

objective.stem: Looking up before climbing to choose which rung to use is a way of ___
Posture means the way we ___
objective.answer: hold our body when we sit or stand
distractors: choose the shoes for the day
eat our food in the morning
write our names in the book

objective.stem: While sitting to write, the feet should be ___
The position we should avoid while sleeping, because it twists the neck, is lying ___
A school bag is best carried on ___
Indoor games are mostly good for training the ___

subobjective.stem: Mention three good feelings that come from playing games.
Name four hard feelings a game can bring.
State four things a game teaches us about living with people.
Give four marching commands we use in class.
Mention four kinds of body exercise learnt this term.
Name four safety rules for climbing.
Mention two kinds of start in a short race and the rule about the lane.
State four rules for good sitting and standing posture.
Name five indoor games we can play in a room.
Give two reasons for balancing indoor games with outdoor play.
points: the eyes need daylight and space

theory.stem: Write on the feelings that come from games and how a child can manage them.
Explain what marching is and give four of its benefits to a pupil.
Describe how you swing, twist, jump and bend in exercise, and say why we warm up first.
